payment.inBrowserBody: Enter your card on the secure page that just opened. Nothing is charged before the owner confirms.
payment.leftBody: Until the hold is placed, nothing is reserved on your card. The Stripe page stays valid for thirty minutes.
payment.abandoned: Request abandoned: your dates are released and nothing was held on your card.

account.admin: Site administration stays on the website.
